listing.name: Crash Team Racing: Nitro-Fueled — CTRNativePorted (guzuold)
listing.summary: For experimental 0.5.9, the project reports completing the game and races between two PCs. Network R8 remains incomplete for more than two players and other cases. Portcove has not confirmed campaign or online play. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own PlayStation 4 CUSA14876 v01.00 game files. v01.21 is required for the optional 60 FPS and Pit Stop features. The README gives abbreviated eboot SHA-256 prefixes; this guide does not include the complete accepted hashes.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the project’s CTRNativePorted-version-win64 ZIP instructions with the launcher, player and matching HLE DLLs, or its separate bootstrap.ps1 source-build route. Select your own base-game and update directories. No other game assets are supplied; Portcove has not inspected a release file.

warnings: For experimental 0.5.9, the project reports completing the game and races between two PCs. Network R8 remains incomplete for more than two players and other cases. Portcove has not confirmed campaign or online play.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
